Source The last two contestants who were evicted from Bigg Boss Telugu 10 are Shalini and Daakshi. Shalini was eliminated through contestant voting, while Daakshi was evicted due to poor audience voting. 
 Shalini was paid Rs 75,000 per week. She stayed in the house for seven weeks, making her total earnings roughly estimated at around Rs 5.25 lakh.
 Daaksha was a wildcard contestant on Bigg Boss Telugu. She did not perform the tasks well and hardly made any friends in the house. She stayed in the house for two weeks. 
 Daaksha’s weekly earnings were Rs 2.5 lakh, bringing her total earnings for two weeks to Rs 5 lakh. These figures for Shalini and Daaksha’s earnings from Bigg Boss Telugu are approximate estimates.
 Bigg Boss Telugu is hosted by Nagarjuna and currently airs on Star Maa and Jio Hotstar.
